Robert Hloz fell in love with fantastic cinema as a kid and fled boring Europe to pursue his dreams in South Korea.

Robert Hloz (1989) is filmmaker based in Prague, Czech Republic. He studied film directing at the film school in South Korea and FMK UTB in Zlín. His early short film The Mill won Kodak Student Gold Award 2011 as the best short film of a year. Numbers, short film shot in Czech-Korean coproduction was premiered in Cannes, Court Métrage section and was subsequently nominated for Czech Academy Award.
